svg.text: Bridges speak real Wayland and real X11 subsets as separate processes — the LDP core never links them, never inherits their bugs.

svg.text: Every module of the wire surface lives in reviewable TOML and is compiled into type-safe Rust by ldpc — the snapshot gate freezes it between releases.
